title: State Atlas of Hospital Resistance and Small Hospitals
description: An open state-by-year table (50 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico, 2011 to 2024; 728 rows) joining CDC Antimicrobial Resistance & Patient Safety Portal percent resistance for methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales and vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecalis and E. faecium (with resistant counts, isolates tested and 95% confidence intervals) to counts of active Medicare-certified short-term acute care and critical access hospitals by certified bed size and rural location from the CMS Provider of Services file (December release of each year). Includes the reproducible pipeline, a quality-assurance report, a codebook, a facility-level hospital list, and a public state map.
